ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The container with which gas would have the greatest pressure?
10.0 g each of three different gases are present in three glass containers of identical volume, as shown below. The temperature of all three flasks is held constant at 298 K.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has three circular glass containers of the same style, labeled SO₂, CH₄, and NCl₃, respectively. The problem statement says that each container has the same volume, the mass of each gas is 10.0 g, and the temperature is kept at 298 K. Reasoning: At the same temperature and the same volume, from the ideal gas law P = nRT/V, pressure P is proportional to the amount of substance n. Compare the amounts of substance of 10.0 g of each gas: the molar mass of SO₂ is about 64.1 g/mol, so n ≈ 10.0/64.1 = 0.156 mol; the molar mass of CH₄ is about 16.0 g/mol, so n ≈ 10.0/16.0 = 0.625 mol; the molar mass of NCl₃ is about 120.4 g/mol, so n ≈ 10.0/120.4 = 0.083 mol. CH₄ has the largest amount of substance, so at the same volume and temperature it has the greatest pressure.

raw_record.question_text: Among $SO_2$, $CH_4$, and $NCl_3$, which gas would have the greatest pressure if 10.0 g of each gas were placed in identical-volume glass containers at 298 K?

method.method_draft: Read the three gas labels from the image. From the text, note that 10.0 g of each gas is placed in identical-volume containers at 298 K. Compute moles for each using n = mass/molar mass: CH4 has far more moles per 10.0 g than SO2 or NCl3 because it has the smallest molar mass. Since P = nRT/V and T and V are the same for all containers, the gas with the largest n has the greatest pressure; select CH4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个相同样式的圆形玻璃容器，标签分别为 SO₂、CH₄ 和 NCl₃。题干说明每个容器体积相同，每种气体质量都是 10.0 g，温度都保持在 298 K。

推理：在相同温度和相同体积下，由理想气体定律 P = nRT/V 可知，压力 P 与物质的量 n 成正比。比较 10.0 g 各气体的物质的量：SO₂ 的摩尔质量约为 64.1 g/mol，所以 n ≈ 10.0/64.1 = 0.156 mol；CH₄ 的摩尔质量约为 16.0 g/mol，所以 n ≈ 10.0/16.0 = 0.625 mol；NCl₃ 的摩尔质量约为 120.4 g/mol，所以 n ≈ 10.0/120.4 = 0.083 mol。CH₄ 的物质的量最大，因此在相同体积和温度下压力最大。
